newsitem.title: CANADA: FALCONBRIDGE UNION PREPARING COUNTER OFFER.
newsitem.headline: FALCONBRIDGE UNION PREPARING COUNTER OFFER.

text.p: The union representing Falconbridge Ltd's striking Ontario workers said on Tuesday it was preparing a response to the company's latest proposal on the key issue of shift scheduling.
A union subcommittee delivered a shift proposal to Falconbridge negotiators last Friday and received the company's counter offer late on Monday.

"The company gave us their response late yesterday and we're now presently reviewing it and preparing a counter response," Rolly Gauthier, local 598 president of the Canadian Auto Workers union, said in a telephone interview on Tuesday.
Union and company negotiators have not met since about 1,400 workers walked off the job on August 1.
Gauthier said he could not comment on the company's counter offer. He added the subcommittee would meet with Falconbridge negotiators "hopefully either later today or early (Wednesday) morning."
Falconbridge officials were unavailable for comment.
Falconbridge's Sudbury operations last year produced 45,700 metric tons of nickel, 50,000 metric tons of copper and 1,600 metric tons of cobalt, including custom feed.
